description: This file defines a class 'AzureBlobStorageGrainJournalingProviderBuilder' that implements the 'IProviderBuilder' interface for configuring Azure Blob Storage journaling provider within Orleans Silo. It contains logic to set up storage options based on configuration settings, including container name, service key, and connection string.

classes.name: AzureBlobStorageGrainJournalingProviderBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds and configures an Azure Blob Storage journaling provider for Orleans Silo, implementing the IProviderBuilder interface.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to use Azure Blob Storage for journaling, setting options based on provided configuration section.
